standard_prerequisites.name: Every morphism in the derived category between such complexes is represented by an actual map of complexes, well defined up to homotopy (derived-lemma-morphisms-from-projective-complex)

standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the representatives f^bullet, gamma_1^bullet, gamma_2^bullet the computation acts on.

core_obligations: Choose P^bullet bounded finite projective with alpha: P^bullet -> K an isomorphism in D(Lambda); by the projective-complex lemma alpha^{-1} f alpha is represented by a map of complexes f^bullet, well defined up to homotopy, and Tr(f) is defined as the alternating sum of the traces of f^i (proof lines 1058-1065). Independence of the choice of f^bullet: another choice differs by dh + hd, and Tr(dh) = -Tr(hd) by reindexing the alternating sum (proof lines 1068-1077), so the total trace is unchanged (proof line 1077). Independence of the choice of (P^bullet, alpha): for (Q^bullet, beta) the composites represent gamma_1^bullet, gamma_2^bullet with gamma_1^bullet gamma_2^bullet homotopic to the identity (proof lines 1079-1087); then gamma_2^bullet f^bullet gamma_1^bullet represents beta^{-1} f beta on Q^bullet, and its trace equals Tr(gamma_1^bullet gamma_2^bullet f^bullet) by cyclicity of the trace in the commutator quotient, which equals Tr(f^bullet) by the homotopy invariance just established (proof lines 1089-1096).
proof_roadmap: Define Tr(f) via a representative on a bounded finite projective complex and check invariance under homotopy (proof lines 1058-1077).
Check invariance under the choice of representative complex via cyclicity and the homotopy invariance (proof lines 1079-1096).
